items.text: Chiefs officially ruled out RB Kenneth Walker III for Thursday night vs Bills due to groin injury; rookie Emmett Johnson starts for third straight game.
items.why: Groin; not ready after limited practice.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup elevated; Walker ROS timeline uncertain.

items.text: Puka Nacua and TE Terrance Ferguson are out for the season; Nacua underwent MCL surgery with 4-5 month recovery timeline, confirming end of 2026 campaign after prior IR placement.
items.why: MCL surgery recovery 4-5 months; Schefter/Rapoport corroborate no postseason return likely.
items.implication: Rams WR room thin (Adams still out); monitor depth like Atwell/Mumpfield for targets/snaps.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for remaining Rams pass-catchers and Kyren Williams in offense.

items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten did not practice Wednesday due to foot/ankle injuries after re-aggravation in Week 11; status trending toward GTD or possible rest vs Titans.
items.why: Re-aggravated prior ankle/foot; coach notes business as usual DNPs then Friday decision; possible rest in soft matchup.
items.implication: Monitor closely; if OUT, backup (e.g. Rodriguez) sees lead volume.

items.text: Berry places Bo Nix on HATE list for Week 12; expects heavy Jonah Coleman usage vs Pittsburgh and insufficient Nix rushing production; ranks outside top 20 QBs.
items.why: Coleman averaging high snaps/rush share without Harvey; Nix rushing not making up for it.
items.implication: Sit/stream elsewhere; Coleman upside in matchup.

items.text: Levitan on Etienne (now Saints): expects disappointing snaps and routes down the stretch despite reasonably high carry count; favorable ARZ/ATL in Weeks 16/17. Cites recent timeshare with Donaldson (32 snaps each) and prior shares post-contract.
items.why: Graziano report + snap data showing heavy committee; routes limited.
items.implication: RB2/flex with carry-dependent floor, lower ceiling without pass work; hold for playoff schedule.
items.conflict: Volume optimists may overrate pure touches.

items.text: Berry notes Derrick Henry target share jumped from under 6% (1.3 rec/game first 9) to 12% and 4.5 receptions in two games with Jacoby Brissett; raises PPR floor.
items.why: Pass-game involvement spike with new QB.
items.implication: Higher floor in PPR; monitor if holds. Note: separate concussion protocol mention elsewhere.

items.text: Colts cut Daniel Jones; Anthony Richardson set to start. Part of Week 12 preview alongside other notes.
items.implication: Potential shift in Colts offense pace/script for JT and pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Monitor AR dual-threat impact on RB usage.

items.text: DeVonta Smith saw 57% target share in Week 11; averages 36% over 5 games and 50% of Eagles end-zone targets; role elite despite injury-impacted season.
items.why: Massive share and RZ involvement even without full Hurts.
items.implication: Must-start WR1 upside if healthy; Ride-or-Die validation.

items.text: Ladd McConkey posted season-high 38% target share and 20.7 fantasy points in return; averages 17.5 PPG when at 20%+ target share (limited full-snap games).
items.implication: Solid WR option if stays healthy; big IF.

items.text: Since Rico Dowdle return Week 6, Jaylen Warren has only 51% of Steelers rush attempts, sub-10% targets in 3/5 games; RB20 utilization, now mid-low RB2.
With Kyle Monangai back Week 11, D'Andre Swift dropped to 47% snaps and 39% rush attempts; sub-10% targets in 4/5 Monangai-active games; mid-low RB2.
Trey McBride 39% target share (19 targets) over past 2 weeks with backup QBs, but aDOT only 3 yards and 1/19 10+ air yards; volume keeps top-5 TE PPR but efficiency down to 11.8 PPG.
items.why: High share but short targets without Brissett.
items.implication: Still startable TE1 on volume; lower ceiling.
items.conflict: Elite TE expectation vs current output.

items.text: Among 43 WRs with 50+ targets, Emeka Egbuka ranks 41st in yards per route run (1.05); poor efficiency continues.
items.implication: Avoid or fade; efficiency drag on fantasy.

items.text: In first game with full Unc Trio active (49ers), routes on 28 dropbacks: Keenan Allen 19, Deebo Samuel 17, Mike Evans 16; others limited. Kirk/Pearsall season-ending.
items.implication: Evans viable but shared; Deebo solid.
